补齐成员兴趣、行动限制、时间与预算。: Complete member interests, mobility limits, time and budget.
展示路线取舍，让成员修改活动，不强迫少数成员接受。: Show route trade-offs and editable activities; do not force minority acceptance.
成员确认的行程版本及未决事项可查看。: Show the confirmed itinerary version and unresolved items.
意见未一致时保留多个方案，不替全家自动订购。: Retain alternatives without consensus; do not order automatically for the family.
核对停放诉求、现场证据、请求者权限和允许移动范围。: Verify parking request, site evidence, requester authority and allowed movement.
解释停放情况，选择允许的新位置，向专用移车系统交接。: Explain parking, select a permitted new position and hand over relocation.
核实交接受理、实际位置和移车完成状态。: Verify handover acceptance, actual position and completion.
恶意指令或无法确认的诉求不执行，转交车主并核实接收。: Reject malicious or unverified requests; refer to the owner and verify receipt.
确认人格风格、适用成员和表达边界。: Confirm personality, applicable members and expression limits.
试听幽默或克制的回应，用户纠正措辞并切回简洁模式。: Preview humorous or restrained responses; allow wording correction and concise mode.
确认当前人格配置与长期保存的内容和范围。: Confirm current configuration and long-term saved content and scope.
人格不能产生操作授权；不喜欢的风格可修改或删除。: Personality grants no operational permission; unwanted styles can be changed or deleted.
确认平稳目标、乘员反馈及车型允许调整的设置。: Confirm smoothness goals, feedback and permitted vehicle settings.
比较路线、内容与底盘舒适选项，确认后交由对应系统执行。: Compare routes, content and chassis options; confirmed changes go to the relevant system.
分别查看设置状态与乘员反馈，不以模式切换代表舒适改善。: Check settings and feedback separately; a mode switch does not prove comfort gain.
底盘接口不可用时只提供可用方案，不让座舱模型直接控制安全功能。: Offer available options only; the cabin model must not directly control safety functions.
确认参与乘客、故事主题和允许使用的沿途线索。: Confirm participants, story theme and permitted roadside clues.
成员选剧情分支、口述推理，让现场对象进入共同冒险。: Members choose branches and speak reasoning, bringing real objects into the adventure.
保存本轮剧情位置与成员选择，能暂停再继续。: Retain story position and choices for pause and resume.
对象识别不准时请成员确认；不向驾驶者分配观察游戏任务。: Ask members to verify recognition errors; do not assign observation games to drivers.
确认目的地、返回时间、可用停车设施和接回点。: Confirm destination, return time, available parking and pickup point.
比较停车与步行安排，在兼容场地向专用停车系统交接。: Compare parking and walking; hand over to a dedicated parking system at compatible sites.
核实停放位置、取回安排及实际接回状态。: Verify parking position, retrieval plan and actual pickup.
设施不支持或接回点受阻时说明限制，重新选择人工方案。: Explain unsupported facilities or blocked pickup; select a manual alternative.
确认人数、忌口、预算、取餐时间和付款主体。: Confirm party, dietary limits, budget, collection time and payer.
汇总菜单和总价，支持逐人改菜，确认后提交订单。: Show menu and total; allow individual changes before confirmed submission.
核实订单号、支付状态、取餐时间与地点。: Verify order ID, payment, collection time and location.
下单超时先查支付与订单，避免重复扣款或重复订餐。: After timeout, check payment and order before retry to avoid duplicates.
确认物品外观、可能出现时间与允许检索的素材。: Confirm item appearance, likely time and permitted media.
展示最后可见位置和时间，用户可追问相邻画面。: Show last visible location and time, supporting adjacent-image questions.
位置陈述有对应片段；最后可见不等于现在仍在。: Support location claims with clips; last seen does not mean still present.
画面缺失时明确未找到证据，不凭推测报位置。: State when no evidence is found; do not guess a location.
确认安全停驻、可隔离游戏输入和参与者。: Confirm safe parking, isolated game inputs and participants.
预览方向盘映射与触觉强度，玩家调整后进入赛车。: Preview wheel mapping and haptic intensity; players adjust before starting.
核实输入已隔离、游戏接收正常及输出通道状态。: Verify isolation, game input receipt and actual output states.
隔离无法确认时不启用方向盘输入，改用手柄或退出。: Without verified isolation, use a controller or exit.
确认航班信息来源、接人时间与后续承诺。: Confirm flight source, pickup time and subsequent commitments.
呈现提前或延误对计划的影响，让用户选调整范围。: Show schedule impacts of early or delayed arrival; let users choose change scope.
刷新后的航班时间与已更新的接送事项。: Verify refreshed flight time and updated pickup tasks.
信息过期先刷新；变更已有订单前检查原授权和取消条件。: Refresh stale data; check permission and cancellation before changing orders.
确认是哪次旅行及可用照片、留言和定位记录。: Confirm trip and permitted photos, messages and location records.
对照素材查找地点，共同编辑回顾，区分原始记忆与生成旁白。: Find places from material and co-edit recollections, separating memory from generated narration.
回顾中的事实有来源，草稿保存与分享分别有回执。: Facts have sources; draft saving and sharing each need receipts.
找不到记录时请求线索；错误回忆可纠正，不生成虚假经历。: Request clues for missing records; correct false memories rather than invent experiences.
确认停驻、休息时长、唤醒方式和需要的环境。: Confirm parking, rest duration, wake-up method and environment.
预览座椅与声光配置，用户确认后开始休息。: Preview seat and ambience setup; start after confirmation.
核实设置、计时与唤醒状态，结束后检查恢复结果。: Verify settings, timer and waking; check restoration afterward.
设备失败说明未生效项；提前结束时保留用户另行修改的设置。: Report ineffective devices; preserve independent user changes when ending early.
确认临时任务地点、截止时间和原行程必须保留的目标。: Confirm errand location, deadline and indispensable original goals.
比较顺路与绕行方案，说明新增任务对到达时间的影响。: Compare on-route and detour plans, explaining arrival impact.
核实路线更新与任务插入顺序。: Verify route update and insertion order.
时间约束冲突时让用户取舍，不悄悄删除原任务。: Ask users to resolve timing conflicts; never silently remove original tasks.
确认停车事件、允许查看的片段与车主处理目标。: Confirm parking event, permitted clips and owner's handling goal.
呈现关键证据，车主选择留档、联系或预约服务。: Show evidence; the owner chooses records, contact or service.
分别核实证据导出与服务联系结果。: Verify evidence export and service contact separately.
疑似碰擦不能当作已确定事故；联系请求不等于对方已接收。: Suspected contact is not a confirmed accident; sending contact does not prove receipt.
确认借用双方、时段、车辆权限和归还要求。: Confirm lender, borrower, time window, permissions and return requirements.
共同核对交接清单，分别确认偏好配置与临时访问范围。: Check a shared handover list; separately confirm preferences and temporary access.
核实权限有效期、交接确认和归还待办。: Verify permission validity, handover and return tasks.
交接对象变化后重验权限，过期后不继续新的授权操作。: Recheck authority after a recipient change; expired access does not cover new operations.
确认停驻、参加成员、可识别动作与体验强度。: Confirm parking, members, recognizable movements and intensity.
试做举手选分支，成员修改识别方式后进入互动剧情。: Try hand-raise branch selection; revise recognition before the story.
核实分支选择与实际声光触觉输出。: Verify chosen branches and actual effects.
动作误识别先允许改选，不将误识别固化为剧情决定。: Allow correction after misrecognition; do not lock an erroneous branch.
确认用户描述、官方状态来源和异常发生条件。: Confirm observations, official state sources and occurrence conditions.
连接相关记录，解释哪些线索已知、哪些仍需服务检查。: Link records and distinguish known clues from items needing service inspection.
解释中的状态、时间与来源可核对。: State, times and sources remain checkable.
缺少诊断证据时不确定病因，保留原描述供服务人员检查。: Without diagnostic evidence, do not establish a cause; retain observations for service.
确认活动日期、成员、票种、预算及退改条件。: Confirm event date, members, ticket type, budget and refund terms.
比较场次与交通安排，选定座位后明确费用再购票。: Compare times and travel; specify price before confirmed purchase.
核实出票、订单号与往返安排。: Verify issued tickets, order ID and round-trip plan.
库存变化重新选票；支付超时先查结果，避免重复购票。: Reselect after stock changes; check timed-out payments to avoid duplicate purchase.
确认接回入口、用户返回时间和允许的服务场地。: Confirm pickup entrance, return time and permitted site.
展示接回安排，交由专用系统从停放位置驶来。: Show pickup arrangements and hand over arrival to the dedicated system.
核实受理、当前位置与到达接回点回执。: Verify acceptance, current position and arrival receipt.
用户尚未到场或入口受阻时重新协商，不自行扩大接回范围。: Renegotiate absent users or blocked entrances; do not expand service limits autonomously.
由乘客确认不适及愿意尝试的改善方式。: The passenger confirms discomfort and desired changes.
连接当前路段与屏幕状态，提出休息或允许设置调整。: Link road and screen conditions; suggest rest or permitted adjustments.
核实设置变化，并以乘客反馈检查效果。: Verify changes and check effect with passenger feedback.
不适未改善时提供停止体验或休息选项，不声称治疗有效。: Offer stopping or rest if no improvement; do not claim treatment effectiveness.
澄清凉快、安静等目标的必要参数与影响区域。: Clarify required parameters and affected zones for cool or quiet goals.
展示整车组合配方，让用户删去不需要的动作。: Show combined settings; users remove unwanted actions.
逐项核实实际设置，标明未执行部分。: Verify each actual setting and mark unexecuted parts.
单项失败保留成功部分，不重复调整已成功设备。: Retain successes after individual failure; do not repeat successful adjustments.
确认本次旅程、可离线保存资料与信息更新时间。: Confirm trip, offline materials and update times.
进山前预览保存内容，断网后区分可用资料和实时缺口。: Preview saved content before weak connectivity; distinguish available data from live gaps.
核实资料已保存、可读取及其有效时间。: Verify saving, readability and validity time.
离线内容过期时明确说明，不冒充实时营业或路况信息。: Label stale offline information; do not present it as live business or traffic data.
确认参与成员、素材范围、作品重点和分享对象。: Confirm members, media scope, narrative priority and sharing recipients.
成员挑选片段与叙事顺序，AI生成短片草稿供共同修改。: Members select clips and sequence; AI produces an editable shared draft.
核实草稿版本、素材来源，保存与分享分别确认。: Verify version and sources; confirm saving and sharing separately.
有成员不同意出镜时排除相关素材，不默认全员允许公开。: Exclude media of members refusing appearance; do not assume public-sharing consent.
确认孩子主动选择的角色、参与家人和本次故事范围。: Confirm the child's chosen character, participating family and story scope.
把桥梁等见闻加入故事，成员选择分支并能随时暂停。: Add discoveries to the story; members select branches and can pause.
核实剧情进度与用户选择，长期角色记忆单独确认。: Verify progress and choices; confirm long-term character memory separately.
不把沉浸程度当价值；识别失败时请成员描述或改用虚构素材。: Immersion is not proof of value; request descriptions or use fictional material after recognition failure.
设定能源预算、必须保留设备和自动调整范围。: Set energy budget, indispensable devices and adjustment scope.
说明预计可用时长，范围内节能；未授权设备调整先询问。: Explain estimated duration; save within scope and ask before unauthorized device changes.
核实电量、设备开关状态及剩余能源估计依据。: Verify charge, switches and the basis for remaining-energy estimates.
估计不准或设备失联时报告未知，不假称关闭或保证续航。: Report unknown estimates or offline devices; do not falsely claim shutdown or guarantee duration.
确认共享日程、接送责任和可用联系人。: Confirm shared calendar, pickup responsibility and contacts.
展示接送冲突与分工候选，由相关成员确认交接。: Show conflicts and responsibility options; affected members confirm handover.
核实日程版本与接手人确认。: Verify calendar version and recipient confirmation.
未收到接手确认时保留待办，不把发出消息当交接完成。: Unconfirmed handovers stay pending; a sent message is not completion.
确认停驻、允许接入的游戏信息与玩家选择的伴演范围。: Confirm parking, permitted game data and chosen companion scope.
预览解说、挑战和空间反馈，玩家随时关闭某一通道。: Preview commentary, challenges and effects; allow disabling individual channels.
核实游戏状态来源及输出实际生效情况。: Verify state sources and actual output effects.
接入失败退回普通游戏，不用猜测战况干扰玩家。: Without integration, revert to ordinary gaming; do not guess game state.
确认车主允许公开的等待、接送或停放信息。: Confirm information the owner permits publicly displaying.
预览车外文字或语音，收到询问时按公开范围回应。: Preview external text or speech; reply within that scope.
请求超出公开范围时转交车主，不泄露行程和身份细节。: Refer out-of-scope requests; do not disclose itinerary or identity details.
确认长辈本人需求、入口、协助人和用品。: Confirm the older person's needs, entrance, helper and supplies.
汇总上下车准备与停靠方案，相关人员确认各自事项。: Summarize boarding and stopping plans; each person confirms responsibilities.
核实入口信息、接送安排及协助人确认。: Verify entrance, pickup and helper confirmation.
入口或协助人变化时更新计划，不假定有人已在现场接应。: Update changed entrances or helpers; do not assume someone is already waiting.
确认近期困惑、当前车辆状态与可用官方操作说明。: Confirm recent questions, current vehicle state and official instructions.
围绕除雾等问题给出小范围讲解，用户可请求操作演示。: Give focused explanations, with demonstrations on request.
解释对应本车功能，学习记录写入范围可查看。: Match guidance to this vehicle; expose learning-record scope.
无法演示时说明限制，不把一次求助标记成长期能力不足。: Explain demonstration limits; one help request does not establish persistent incapacity.
确认换车身份、目标车辆和允许迁移的偏好与记录。: Confirm identity, target vehicle and permitted preferences and records.
先预览迁移清单，用户删改后适配目标车支持的功能。: Preview transfer; adapt only supported functions after user edits.
核实目标车辆配置与迁移完成项。: Verify target configuration and completed transfer items.
目标车不支持的偏好保持未应用，不用旧车配置冒充成功。: Mark unsupported preferences unapplied; old settings do not prove success.
设定出发时间、准备目标和允许自动执行的事项。: Set departure time, readiness goals and automatic-action limits.
检查补能与预热进度，范围内推进，例外事项再交用户决定。: Check charging and warming; progress within scope and refer exceptions.
逐项核实准备状态，并报告未完成事项。: Verify each readiness item and unfinished tasks.
设备不可用时保留失败项，不将计划启动等同车辆已准备好。: Retain failures; starting preparation does not mean the vehicle is ready.
确认停车位置、手机接续权限和目的地入口。: Confirm parking position, phone handover permission and entrance.
把步行与票务信息交给手机，返程接续找车任务。: Transfer walking and tickets to the phone, then connect return-to-car tasks.
核实手机收到任务、入口信息与停车位置。: Verify phone receipt, entrance information and car position.
手机未接收时保留车端信息，不宣布已无缝交接。: Keep car-side information when receipt is missing; do not claim seamless handover.
确认参与成员、音乐风格与可用哼唱或节奏输入。: Confirm members, music style and humming or rhythm inputs.
成员轮流哼唱或打拍，试听伴奏并口述改写。: Take turns humming or tapping, preview accompaniment and speak revisions.
核实生成版本与成员选择，作品保存另行确认。: Verify versions and choices; confirm saving separately.
等待或识别错误时允许重录、改写或暂停，不覆盖原片段。: Allow rerecording, edits or pause during errors; preserve original clips.
确认外部请求内容、可公开信息和车主转交通道。: Confirm external request, public information and owner-contact channel.
回应可处理问题，敏感或越权请求说明范围并提供联系选项。: Answer permitted questions; explain limits and contact options for sensitive requests.
核实实际回应内容与转交接收状态。: Verify reply content and handover receipt.
无法联系车主时如实说明，不虚构车主答复。: Honestly report failed contact; do not invent owner replies.
确认归家目标、家中设备、取件事项及允许联动范围。: Confirm home goal, devices, collection tasks and permitted connections.
展示到达时间下的任务链，用户可只保留部分步骤。: Show a timed task chain with optional steps.
分别核实设备状态、取件安排与停放事项。: Verify devices, collection and parking separately.
任一服务失败说明已完成部分，再选恢复或人工处理。: Explain successes after service failure; choose recovery or manual handling.
确认乘客选择的景物主题、音乐风格和变化频率。: Confirm chosen scenery, music style and change frequency.
试听海岸等声景，用户调节强度或换风格后持续生成。: Preview a soundscape; continue after intensity or style choices.
核实当前声景和用户选择，不以生成次数代表喜好。: Verify current soundscape and selections; generation count is not preference evidence.
景物不确定时使用用户选定主题，不擅自频繁切歌。: Use the selected theme when scenery is uncertain; avoid unsolicited frequent changes.
确认本人目标、可接受表达方式及家人协助范围。: Confirm the person's goal, preferred explanation and family-help limits.
用简明候选完成常用目标，困惑时提供可选择的协助入口。: Offer simple familiar choices and optional assistance if confused.
核实本人确认与实际任务结果。: Verify personal confirmation and actual outcomes.
未取得本人同意不转交私人信息，不以年龄推定无决定能力。: Do not share private information without consent or infer incapacity from age.
确认每位成员的出镜、素材使用与分享范围。: Confirm each member's appearance, material use and sharing limits.
呈现不同选择如何影响成片，允许局部排除而非全员统一。: Show effects of different choices; allow local exclusions rather than forced uniform consent.
素材使用方案与各主体确认能对应。: Match material-use plans to each person's confirmation.
未解决冲突前不提交共享发布，拒绝不扩大为永久偏好。: Do not publish unresolved shared material; refusal does not imply permanent preference.
确认远程目标、可读取状态及允许准备动作。: Confirm remote goal, readable states and allowed readiness actions.
汇总更新时间，让用户选继续查询还是委托具体准备。: Show update times and offer further queries or specific delegation.
状态来源、更新时间与动作回执分别可查看。: Show state source, update time and action receipts separately.
状态过期先更新，工具无回执时显示未知而非准备完成。: Refresh stale state; missing receipts mean unknown, not ready.
确认营地、成员、活动顺序和允许调整的设备。: Confirm site, members, activity order and adjustable equipment.
预览晚餐到观影的切换，按共同选择联动空间。: Preview dinner-to-film transition; coordinate shared choices.
逐项核实配置与结束恢复结果。: Verify settings and restoration item by item.
能源或设备不足时缩小活动范围，保留未完成准备项。: Reduce scope with limited energy or equipment; retain incomplete preparation items.
确认试乘路段、用户感受和可比较的允许底盘配置。: Confirm comparison route, impressions and permitted chassis configurations.
整理软硬与晃动反馈，选择对照方案再由对应系统执行。: Organize firmness and sway feedback; selected changes go to the responsible system.
配置回执、路段条件和反馈可对应比较。: Match configuration receipts, road conditions and feedback.
条件不可比时不下结论，不将座舱建议直接作为安全控制指令。: Avoid conclusions without comparable conditions; cabin advice is not a safety-control command.
确认场地、物品、取送对象、交接地点与许可。: Confirm site, item, sender, recipient, location and permission.
协调专用移动系统和交接方，显示移动与交付的分阶段状态。: Coordinate dedicated movement and handover parties; show movement and delivery stages.
核实到达与交接证据，分别报告移动和交付结果。: Verify arrival and handover evidence separately.
无人接收或物品不符时暂停交付并协商，不自行变更对象。: Pause for absent recipients or mismatched items; do not autonomously change recipients.

得分与识别事件对应，支持纠正误判。: Match scores to recognition events and support correction.
误识别可重做，有限空间不够时改为轻量或屏幕游戏。: Allow retries; use lighter or screen-based games when space is insufficient.
确认新服务目标、可沿用偏好及其来源和有效期。: Confirm new service goal, reusable preferences, sources and validity.
展示口味、预算等迁移依据，用户纠正后再筛选候选。: Show taste and budget provenance; filter after user corrections.
新选择与被采用的偏好可对应。: Match new choices to adopted preferences.
旧偏好冲突先询问，不将迁移自动扩大为购买授权。: Ask about conflicting old preferences; transfer does not grant purchasing authority.
确认主题目标、允许配置与试验范围。: Confirm theme goal, permitted settings and experiment scope.
预览雨夜爵士等组合，用户删改后尝试并可撤回。: Preview combinations; users edit, try and undo.
核实各设置与保存的配方版本。: Verify each setting and saved recipe version.
配置冲突先选择取舍，不用整体流畅掩盖单项失败。: Resolve configuration conflicts; smooth overall presentation must not hide failures.
确认家庭共同角色、个人偏好和私人记忆边界。: Confirm family role, individual preferences and private-memory limits.
预览对不同成员的表达，共同身份与私人内容分别修改。: Preview member-specific expression; edit common identity and private content separately.
核实共享角色配置与各自记忆范围。: Verify shared configuration and individual memory scope.
共享身份不意味着共享私人记录，冲突先按相关主体协商。: Shared identity does not imply shared private records; negotiate with affected people.
确认目的地、参与乘客与选择的主题。: Confirm destination, passengers and selected theme.
预览海底等音乐与问答，成员调整内容再持续体验。: Preview music and questions; adjust before continued experience.
目的地资料与生成内容分开，输出实际状态可见。: Separate destination facts from generated content; show actual outputs.
不将想象内容说成目的地事实，成员无兴趣时停止主题。: Never present imagination as destination fact; stop when members lose interest.
确认停驻、真实素材、练习目标与难度。: Confirm parking, real material, learning goal and difficulty.
围绕路牌等材料出题，用户回答后讲解并可调难度。: Create questions from signs; explain answers and allow difficulty changes.
答案可对应原素材，练习进度可查看。: Match answers to source material and show progress.
素材无法辨认时换题，不用生成答案伪造现场文字。: Change illegible material; do not fabricate local text with generated answers.
确认任务结束、返位地点、允许路径和待命条件。: Confirm task end, return location, allowed route and standby conditions.
向专用系统交接返位，途中异常交还适当控制主体。: Hand over return to the dedicated system; refer exceptions to the appropriate controller.
核实实际返位、当前状态与待命确认。: Verify actual return, current state and standby confirmation.
位置未知先查证，不将返回请求提交视作已到位。: Verify unknown location; submitting return is not arrival.
人给出具体目标与对象；事实可靠、能力可用、无未解决冲突且获得匹配授权。: The human provides a specific goal and object; facts are reliable, capability available, conflicts resolved and matching permission valid.
人确定目标和具体动作: Human determines goal and specific action
人可纠正或终止，Agent如实反馈: Human may correct or stop; Agent reports honestly
人发起；人确定目标和具体动作；Agent执行已授权动作；人可纠正或终止，Agen: Human initiates; determines goal and action; Agent executes authorized actions; human may correct or stop and receives honest feedback
执行明确动作；后续转入等待回执或结果回报: Execute a specific action, then monitor receipts or report results
把一句含糊指令扩展为组合控制。: Expand an ambiguous command into combined controls.
候选设计机制，非公认分类: Candidate design mechanism, not an established taxonomy
保留范式，明确提交成功、处理中和结果成功为不同状态；直达可靠成功回执时不强制添加: Retain the pattern while separating submission, pending and success; a reliable immediate receipt does not require P11.
Agent发现有事实与能力依据的非紧急机会，当前时机适合，尚未取得拟议动作授权；: The Agent finds a fact-supported, feasible nonurgent opportunity at a suitable time without action permission; it proposes a specific candidate only.
人决定是否采纳及具体动作: Human chooses adoption and specific action
人可拒绝、暂缓并限定拒绝范围: Human may reject, defer and define refusal scope
Agent发起；人决定是否采纳及具体动作；确认前不执行外部动作；人可拒绝、暂缓并: Agent initiates; human decides adoption and action; no external execution before confirmation; human may reject or defer with explicit scope
提出明确候选；采纳后重验目标与动作权限: Propose a specific candidate; after adoption recheck goal and action permission
将建议接受自动扩张为其他动作授权。: Expand accepted advice into permission for other actions.
定义保留，调整导航分组；补建议前也需有足够事实和能力依据，建议采纳绑定到具体动作: Retain definition and revise navigation grouping; facts and capability are required before suggesting, and acceptance binds to specific actions.
人已设定目标、边界和有效授权；Agent可在范围内组织子任务。: The human has defined goals, boundaries and valid permission; the Agent may organize subtasks within them.
人决定目标与边界，Agent选择域内步骤: Human sets goals and limits; Agent selects in-domain steps
人可撤销、纠正；越界节点重新询问: Human may revoke or correct; out-of-scope steps ask again
人授予委托，Agent推进；人决定目标与边界，Agent选择域内步骤；Agent: Human delegates; Agent progresses; human sets goals and limits; Agent selects and executes permitted steps; human may revoke or correct and is consulted at boundaries
保留目标、边界与委托上下文；局部步骤可切换澄清、核实、监测等P，每个新动作提交前: Retain goal, limits and delegation context; switch local patterns for clarification, verification or monitoring and recheck permission and context before each action.
把委托自动扩散至付款、共享数据等新后果。: Automatically extend delegation to payment or new data-sharing consequences.
记录持续委托上下文与当前局部P两个层次；当前步骤可P07/P04/P11，同时保: Track enduring delegation and current local pattern separately; P07, P04 or P11 may operate within original limits.
下一行动所必需的目标、对象或参数不明确。: A goal, object or parameter necessary for the next action is unclear.
人明确需求，Agent呈现歧义: Human specifies needs; Agent exposes ambiguity
人可修改目标；Agent不得把推测当事实: Human may revise goals; Agent must not present inference as fact
任一方触发，Agent澄清；人明确需求，Agent呈现歧义；澄清前不执行目标动作: Either party triggers clarification; human specifies needs; Agent exposes ambiguity and refrains from execution or factual guesses
补齐必要参数，再重验其余条件: Complete necessary parameters, then recheck other conditions
为了形式完整而反复询问无关参数。: Repeatedly ask irrelevant parameters for formal completeness.
保留，补任务级必要参数清单与可接受默认值、澄清后的重验条件。: Retain the pattern; specify necessary fields, permitted defaults and rechecks after clarification.
目标已明确，但当前动作权限缺失、不覆盖或需要重新取得。: The goal is clear, but current action permission is missing, insufficient or must be renewed.
有权主体决定动作与范围: Authorized party decides action and scope
人可拒绝、缩小范围或撤销: Human may refuse, narrow or revoke
Agent请求确认；有权主体决定动作与范围；授权前不执行目标动作；人可拒绝、缩小: Agent requests confirmation; authorized party defines scope; no execution before permission; human may refuse, narrow or revoke
绑定动作、对象和影响后取得确认: Bind action, object and impact before obtaining confirmation
把含糊的“好”绑定到未说明的动作。: Bind an ambiguous yes to undisclosed actions.
明确确认主体、对象、动作、范围；可同一句完成，但分别记录意图和授权证据。: Specify confirmer, object, action and scope; intent and authorization may share a sentence but require separate evidence.
行动影响多位主体，需求或选择权存在未解决冲突。: An action affects multiple people with unresolved needs or authority conflicts.
相关主体协商，采用明确的权利规则: Relevant parties negotiate under explicit authority rules
未解决冲突前不提交共享动作: Do not submit shared actions while conflict is unresolved
各方可纠正；不能默认驾驶员拥有所有决定权: All parties may correct; driver authority is not universal
任一受影响主体可触发；相关主体协商，采用明确的权利规则；未解决冲突前不提交共享动: Any affected person may initiate; parties negotiate explicit authority; shared actions wait for resolution; everyone may correct and the driver does not own every decision
形成范围明确的共同或分区方案: Form a clearly bounded shared or zoned plan
以驾驶员身份覆盖所有乘员的正当需求。: Override all occupants' legitimate needs because one is the driver.
按区域、受影响主体、共享资源定义决定权；分区可独立执行，未解决共享冲突不得提交。: Define decisions by zone, affected people and shared resources; zoned actions may proceed independently but unresolved shared actions may not.
决定或完成声明依赖的事实过期、未知，或执行结果缺乏可靠回执。: Facts needed for decisions or completion are stale or unknown, or execution lacks reliable receipts.
证据补齐后再决定；人可提供事实: Decide after evidence is sufficient; human may provide facts
仅进行许可范围内的查询核实: Queries and verification stay within permission
人可纠正信息；Agent标注不确定性: Human may correct; Agent labels uncertainty
Agent发现证据缺口；证据补齐后再决定；人可提供事实；仅进行许可范围内的查询核: Agent detects gaps; decisions await evidence; human may provide corrections and Agent verifies only within scope while labeling uncertainty
核实目标状态或回执，不能用置信度替代证据: Verify target state or receipts; confidence does not replace evidence
编号保留，增加行动前/结果核验子类型；查询本身也检查权限、隐私和副作用。: Retain ID, with pre-action and result-verification subtypes; queries also require permission, privacy and side-effect checks.
非紧急主动建议仍有价值，但负荷高或时机不明；延后用户可见的建议，不因此延后已知失: A useful nonurgent suggestion faces high or unknown workload. Delay visible advice, not internal verification or recovery of failed or unknown tasks.
人保留决定权；Agent择时重验: Human retains choice; Agent rechecks timing
不执行拟议动作，不立即播报: No proposed execution or immediate announcement
人可恢复、拒绝；时机变化需重验价值: Human may resume or reject; changed timing requires rechecking value
Agent内部触发，暂不打断；人保留决定权；Agent择时重验；不执行拟议动作，: Agent evaluates without interruption; human retains choice; no immediate execution or announcement; resumption requires rechecking timing and value
保留候选，等待适合时机；过期则抑制: Retain the candidate until a suitable time; suppress if expired
延后结束后不检查价值而补发失效建议。: Replay an obsolete suggestion without rechecking value.
区分延后播报与延后内部核实、恢复；普通建议可延后，不默认把失败处理一起暂停。: Distinguish deferred speech from deferred verification and recovery; delaying ordinary advice must not pause failure handling.
完成原动作的工具或能力不足，但存在可以解释的替代方式。: The original tool or capability is insufficient, but an explainable alternative exists.
人选择替代目标或手动处理: Human chooses an alternative goal or manual handling
人可放弃；Agent不声称原任务已完成: Human may abandon; Agent cannot claim the original task complete
Agent说明能力缺口；人选择替代目标或手动处理；只执行被选择且授权的替代操作；: Agent explains gaps; human chooses alternatives or manual handling; only authorized selections execute; abandonment is possible without false original completion
收缩目标、切换可行路径，重新核验权限: Narrow the goal, choose a feasible path and recheck permission
用缓存或替代结果冒充原能力和实时信息。: Present cached or alternative results as the original capability or live information.
区分可提供替代与无可行替代；后者解释能力限制并结束/适当转交，不虚构替代方案。: Distinguish viable alternatives from none; explain limits and end or appropriately hand over rather than invent an option.
越界拒绝与适当转交: Refuse out-of-domain requests and hand over appropriately
请求不属于产品允许执行域，或属于当前无法取得执行许可的禁止行为；域内仅缺少可补齐: A request lies outside the permitted product domain or is prohibited without obtainable permission. Use P05 for in-domain permission that can be supplied.
原决定权交还有权主体或专用系统: Return decision authority to the authorized party or dedicated system
Agent不执行越界动作: Agent does not execute out-of-domain actions
人使用适当通道；转交不等于已被接收: Human uses an appropriate channel; handover is not accepted receipt
请求或事件触发；原决定权交还有权主体或专用系统；Agent不执行越界动作；人使用: Request or event triggers; authority returns to the proper party or system; Agent refuses out-of-domain execution and does not equate referral with receipt
说明边界，并提供可用的适当通道: Explain boundaries and offer available appropriate channels
虚构转交成功或让不具备能力的人承担处置。: Invent successful handover or assign handling to incapable people.
P10用于产品禁止或当前无法合法取得的边界；域内可补授权走P05；转交有独立接收: P10 addresses prohibited or currently unauthorized domain boundaries; use P05 for obtainable in-domain permission and verify handover receipt separately.
先前动作已提交但尚无可靠完成证据；允许观测和核实先前动作，后续新动作仍需单独核验: An action was submitted without reliable completion evidence. Observe and verify it, but separately recheck permission for new actions.
原任务边界不变；新目标另行决定: Original limits remain; new goals require new decisions
核实已提交动作的状态；新动作或继续提交子任务须重验当前权限: Verify submitted action state; new submissions or subtasks require current permission checks
人可取消或接管，Agent区分提交与完成: Human may cancel or take over; Agent distinguishes submission from completion
Agent监测，用户可查询；原任务边界不变；新目标另行决定；核实已提交动作的状态: Agent monitors and user queries; original limits remain; new goals and actions require permission checks; human may cancel or take over with clear submission versus completion status
报告进度或保持可观察状态，等待回执: Report progress or preserve observability while awaiting receipts
频繁播报进度或用“请求已发出”代表成功。: Over-announce progress or treat a sent request as success.
持续观测已提交动作与提交新的子动作分开；后者重验权限，撤销后仍可核实先前动作状态: Separate observing existing submissions from submitting new subtasks; recheck new permissions and continue verifying earlier actions after revocation.
已发生失败、部分失败，或进入需要补偿、重试的恢复阶段。: Failure or partial failure has occurred, or retry or compensation is needed.
在既有明确重试范围内恢复；范围不足时由人决定重试、补偿或放弃: Recover within explicit retry scope; otherwise human chooses retry, compensation or abandonment
仅在验证恢复条件和必要授权后执行: Execute only after checking recovery conditions and required permission
人可接管；Agent逐动作核实，不保证回滚: Human may take over; Agent verifies each action without rollback guarantees
Agent或人发现失败；在既有明确重试范围内恢复；范围不足时由人决定重试、补偿或: Agent or human detects failure; recover within explicit retry limits or seek a choice; verify conditions and permission without promising rollback
保留已知成功部分，核实失败，再协商下一步: Retain known successes, verify failure and negotiate next steps
盲目重试、重复成功动作或宣称不可逆操作已回滚。: Blindly retry, repeat successful actions or claim irreversible operations rolled back.
明确重试权限、次数、幂等性、部分成功与补偿范围；既有授权覆盖时可按其范围重试，否: Define retry scope, counts, idempotency, partial success and compensation; valid existing permission may cover retry, otherwise renegotiate.
用户撤销当前安排或接管；需区分动作是否已提交。: The user revokes an arrangement or takes over; distinguish submitted from unsubmitted actions.
人控制后续；已提交动作须核实可撤销性: Human controls next steps; verify cancelability of submitted actions
停止新的动作；必要时请求取消并核实: Stop new actions; request and verify cancellation where needed
Agent说明哪些已提交、哪些停下；人决定后续: Agent states submitted and stopped parts; human decides next steps
人触发停止或接管；人控制后续；已提交动作须核实可撤销性；停止新的动作；必要时请求: Human stops or takes over; controls future actions; Agent checks cancelability, stops new submissions and reports actual outcomes
停止新提交，确认取消结果或进入恢复: Stop new submissions; verify cancellation or enter recovery
立即把取消意图说成取消成功。: Immediately describe a cancellation request as successful cancellation.
保留，补已受理/执行中/部分完成/不可逆/未知的逐动作停止及恢复路径。: Retain the pattern and define per-action stopping and recovery for accepted, ongoing, partial, irreversible or unknown states.
拟把本次信息写入长期偏好或长期安排；范围尚需明确。: Information may become a long-term preference or arrangement; its scope needs clarification.
人明确记住什么、多久和如何更改: Human chooses what, for how long and how to revise it
未取得写入授权前不保存长期信息: No long-term saving before write permission
人可修改、删除；Agent不把一次行为等同长期偏好: Human may edit or delete; one action is not a permanent preference
任一方提出记忆意图；人明确记住什么、多久和如何更改；未取得写入授权前不保存长期信: Either party proposes memory; human determines content and duration; saving awaits permission; edits and deletion remain available without permanent-preference inference
明确内容、用途、主体、期限；仅本行程可确认临时范围，长期保存作为独立授权动作并核: Specify content, use, person and duration; temporary trip scope may be agreed, while lasting storage is a separately authorized action with a receipt.
从一次拒绝自动推断永久偏好。: Infer a permanent preference from one refusal.
区分记忆内容、用途、期限、主体与写入许可；写入作为动作，需回执，修改删除同样可追: Separate memory content, use, duration, person and write permission; verify and trace writes, edits and deletion.
价值失效或范围内抑制: Suppress expired value or explicit refusal scope
当前主动机会已失效，或当前提醒/拟议行为命中明确拒绝范围；记忆仅限本行程不直接意: An opportunity has expired or a suggestion matches explicit refusal scope. Trip-only memory does not itself imply suppression.
沿用人已明确的拒绝范围: Follow the human's explicit refusal scope
不提交拟议动作，不重复提醒: Do not submit proposed actions or repeat reminders
人可更改；新范围或新行程重新判断: Human may revise; reassess new scopes or journeys
Agent内部判断，通常不发声；沿用人已明确的拒绝范围；不提交拟议动作，不重复提: Agent assesses usually silently; respects refusal scope without action or repetition; human may revise and new journeys are reassessed
保持安静或只确认本次范围，不写入长期偏好: Stay quiet or confirm current scope only; do not write permanent preferences
把本行程拒绝扩大为永久偏好。: Extend a trip-specific refusal to a permanent preference.
以当前提醒/拟议行为的抑制为核心；“仅本行程”只限制持续范围，是否发声/临时记忆: Suppress the current proposed behavior; trip-only limits duration, while speech and temporary memory depend on the request.
存在可靠结果证据，且回报对象、动作与实际轨迹匹配。: Reliable outcome evidence exists and matches the reported object, action and actual sequence.
不新增动作；人决定下一目标: No new action; human chooses the next goal
只呈现结果，不自动继续新任务: Present results only; do not start another task automatically
人可质疑或纠正；Agent提供适当来源: Human may challenge or correct; Agent provides appropriate sources
Agent或用户查询触发；不新增动作；人决定下一目标；只呈现结果，不自动继续新任: Agent or query triggers; no new actions; human selects next goals, challenges or corrects results and can inspect sources
说明已完成事项、范围和证据；新目标重新进入决策: State completed work, scope and evidence; a new goal starts a new decision
因整体体验顺畅而隐去部分失败。: Hide partial failure because the overall experience felt smooth.
保留，补动作ID、来源、时间、结果范围和部分成功判定；新目标另起决策。: Retain pattern; include action ID, source, time, result scope and partial success; decide new goals separately.
车辆安全控制不在本示范座舱Agent执行域。: Vehicle safety control is outside this example cockpit Agent's execution domain.
仅部分分支有合成契约检验；未开展用户实验: Only some branches have synthetic contract checks; no user experiments performed
示范范围之外须重新审查，不能自动迁移: Outside the example scope, review again; do not transfer automatically
保留当前范围；未来执行域按产品/适配器许可显式配置，不能仅靠用户授权扩大产品域。: Retain scope; configure future execution domains by explicit product or adapter permissions, not user authorization alone.
每个有外部后果的动作需核验授予者、对象、动作与参数范围。: Every consequential external action must check grantor, object, action and parameter limits.
规定目标/查询/写入/恢复动作的核验对象；完成动作绑定与提交前再次核验，既有有效: Define checks for goals, queries, writes and recovery; bind actions and recheck before submission without interrupting for already valid permission.
到期、撤销或授权对象/动作变更后须停止原授权下的新动作。: Stop new actions under old permission after expiry, revocation or changes to action or object.
区分新提交禁令、持续动作停止请求、状态查询和必要补偿；不把撤销授权等同于已撤销执: Separate new-submission bans, ongoing-action stop requests, state queries and necessary compensation; revoking permission does not mean execution was canceled.
